name: Enterprise Footer
description: A dark bordered-panel mega footer: a left brand panel (logo + star rating badge) beside a six-column link grid, over a bottom bar with follow, legal links, and copyright, separated by divider hairlines.
interactions: container-width responsive: a ResizeObserver measures the section's own width and toggles fch-md (<900px) and fch-sm (<560px) — layout adapts to the container, not the viewport
fch-md stacks the brand panel over the links, hides the rating badge, and drops the grid to two columns; fch-sm tightens padding and wraps the bottom bar
links fade to a brand-tint hover color; the social and legal links shift on hover (200ms)
